title: The BSMT
features:
BSMT Hub — War Tycoon
BSMT is a combat-focused War Tycoon script built with one goal: to kill. It packs a complete aim suite, weapon modification, base automation, and a full visual/ESP package into one clean, mobile-friendly UI.
— SAFETY FIRST —
Your safety is our first priority. On execution, BSMT runs a built-in version-integrity check: it hashes the game's core scripts and compares the result against a verified, known-good version. If War Tycoon receives an update and anything changes, you are notified instantly that the build may be outdated, so you never blindly run a broken or unsafe script.
COMBAT
• Silent Aim
• Show FOV + FOV Radius
• Wallcheck
• Wallbang
• Tracers + Tracer Color
• Rocket Spam (Stinger rockets home onto the nearest enemy) (works with both Stinger and RPG)
• RPG Silent Aim (RPG rockets auto-hit the closest target)
• Instant LockOn (instant missile lock for Stinger/Javelin)
• LockOn Players
• LockOn Wall Check
• Kill Aura (Rage) + Wall Check + Target Limit + Ignore Forcefield
• Shoot While Sprinting (fire & reload mid-sprint, keeps your speed)
• Keep Gun In Water (no more auto-unequip in water)
• No Oxygen Drain (zero suffocation damage underwater)
GUN MOD
• Enable Gun Mod (customize your weapons)
• No Recoil
• No Spread
• Full Auto (makes any gun full-auto)
• Instant Reload
• Fire Rate
• Bullet Speed
• Range
• Bullets/Shot
ROCKET MANIPULATION
• Instant Homing — rocket snaps straight onto the target
• Rockets Ignore Walls — blast lands on the target even through a wall
• No Gravity — rocket flies flat, no drop
• Acceleration Control
• Tracking Distance — rocket keeps its lock from much farther
• Tracking Angle — locks targets at wider angles
• Battery Life — rocket tracks longer before giving up
• Proximity Fuse Radius — detonates near the target instead of needing a direct hit
• Guided Rocket Control for Stinger, Javelin and other homing rockets
• Homing / Turn Speed — how hard the rocket curves onto the target
• Rocket Speed
• Explosion Radius
• Instant Rocket Reload for Stinger, RPG and Javelin
ROCKET ORBIT
• Client-side Orbit (Fun tab) — fire an RPG or Stinger and the rocket circles you instead of flying off. Visual only, on your screen.
• Stinger Orbit (Manipulation tab) (beta) — the REAL rocket, server-side so other players see it too. Fire with no lock-on and it circles you, phasing through walls. Toggles to make it explode on players and/or vehicles it sweeps past.
BASE / TYCOON
• Auto Build (auto-buys tycoon buttons)
• Target Lowest Price
• Target Rebirth Buttons
• CRAM Kill Aura (auto-fires your CRAM at targets)
→ Target Players / Helicopters / Vehicles / Planes / Tanks / Boats / Drones
→ Ignore LP Vehicles
→ Setup button to arm the CRAM
→ Notifications — tells you if you own a CRAM + who/what it's targeting
→ New Bullet Tracers toggle (CRAM → target)
WORLD
• Grenade Alert
• Airdrop Alert
• Obstacle Hit Alert
• Auto Farm (auto-steals crates/airdrops to your collector)
• Target Crates / Target Airdrops
• Crate ESP (Name / Distance / Status / Ignore Own Crates)
VISUALS
• Player ESP (Name, Box, Health Bar, Backpack Items, Skeleton, Tracers)
• Box Style (Full / Corner / 3D)
• Tracer Origin (Bottom / Top / Mouse / Center) + Tracer Color
• Chams (Fill / Outline / Occluded color + transparency)
• Minimap Player Dots (works on minimap + full map) + Enemies Only
LOCALPLAYER
• Fly + Fly Speed
• No Fall Damage
• Noclip
• Spin Bot (anti-aim) + Spin Speed

and many more...
